column1: # Context-budget canaries: rules that must stay ALWAYS-LOADED (CLAUDE.md or a rule without `paths:`).
# `bash .claude/scripts/check-context-budget.sh --strict` fails when an anchor is missing from every
# always-loaded file, so trimming the corpus cannot silently delete them.
# Pin a rule only when (a) breaking it is costly or irreversible and (b) no hook or CI gate already
# enforces it mechanically. One fixed-string anchor per rule (no regex), copied verbatim from the rule.
# Moving a rule between always-loaded files keeps it green; moving it to a skill or a path-scoped rule
# turns it red, which is the point: decide that explicitly and edit this file in the same change.
